name: Buizel
description: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: The user adapts a hard-hitting stance to increase the damage dealt by its moves by 50 percent.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
